conclusion: On clean labels (outlier_fraction 0.0) at seed 7, OLS achieved lower MSE (0.17046895861013783) than the matched training-mean predictor (12.888358499556563), so OLS outperformed the baseline on this single seed and metric.
limitations: Only seed 7 and mse were run; seeds 19 and 31 and mae/median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single-seed, single-metric result; no variance or significance assessment.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
